takes.title: Backstroke with pronounced torso roll
takes.actionDescription: The performer lies face up, cycles the arms overhead one at a time and rolls the shoulders from side to side with small kicks.

takes.title: Backstroke with long alternating reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer maintains a largely extended face-up posture, reaching and recovering each arm in turn with a steady kick.

takes.title: Breaststroke with a long glide
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly draws the hands inward, extends both arms forward and straightens the legs after a bent-knee kick.

takes.title: Breaststroke with compact recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer cycles both arms forward and outward from a compact chest-level position while bending and straightening both legs together.

takes.title: Breaststroke with a wide kick and feet-together finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer sweeps the arms symmetrically and opens the knees for a broad kick, then draws the arms and legs together.

takes.title: Butterfly with a raised chest and wide recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts the head and chest, recovers both arms in broad arcs, and drives a paired kick through the rise and fall of the torso.

takes.title: Butterfly with repeated forward reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer cycles both arms together from a downward pull into a long forward reach as the knees and hips pulse through successive kicks.

takes.title: Butterfly with arms extended to the sides
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms wide during the recovery, then pulls them down in front as the lower legs kick together.

takes.title: Butterfly with a compact pull
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates a broad two-arm recovery with a tucked pull near the torso, keeping the legs together through repeated body waves.

takes.title: Freestyle with alternating shoulder rotation
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates one arm reaching ahead with the other recovering, rotating the torso as the legs continue kicking.

takes.title: Freestyle with short arm recoveries
takes.actionDescription: The performer remains low and face down, cycling one bent arm past the torso while the other extends, with compact alternating kicks.

takes.title: Freestyle with a long reaching stroke
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches one arm well ahead while the other sweeps back, rolls from side to side through repeated strokes, and lifts the head near the end.

takes.title: Motorcycle pose with elbows bent
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the knees flexed and torso slightly forward, holding both elbows bent and the hands raised in a steady stance.

takes.title: Range-of-motion sequence with an open-arm finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through varied arm sweeps, body turns, bends and leg lifts, rounding out the sequence with both arms extended sideways.
